original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 1 SKU Number exactly identifies the approved sellable/build configuration, or follows a documented unsupported rule, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect full Type 1, correlate SKU Number with Product Name, configuration/BOM and asset record, reject placeholders or wrong variants, run the approved reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves exact SKU/configuration mapping and plan. Collection, comparison and reboot are automatable.
safety_requirements: Preserve full Type 1/errors before extracting SKU.
Do not accept Product Name, family, generic label, blank or placeholder as SKU without an explicit recipe.
Stop on wrong-configuration mapping, unexpected absence, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 1/tool/configuration identity, compare SKU to the exact approved configuration or supported-absent rule before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, infer a SKU from partial hardware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve configuration/BOM-to-SKU mapping and absence/alias rules.
Resolve manufacturing identity discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 1 is appropriate, but grep-only output, hidden errors and insecure transport reduce reliability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 1 and tool/version output with approved transport, then extract record-scoped SKU Number before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, SKU Number scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind SKU Number to the actual BOM/configuration and Product Name/asset record, distinguish supported absence from placeholder provisioning, and compare across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved product/BOM/SKU recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds configuration-level provenance and explicit absent/placeholder semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multiple configurations may share Product Name but require different SKU values.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a customer SKU or documented absent field for its exact configuration; the report must name the configuration and rule.
expected_evidence: Approval, SKU/BOM/product/asset mapping and tool version
Raw pre-reboot Type 1 plus exact SKU/absence evaluation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently define the SKU check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field/method are clear; configuration mapping/package/window are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains Type 1 collection but adds configuration provenance and complete evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps supported-absence/recovery controls while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes SKU from product/family and binds it to BOM.

review_improvement: Prevents a valid-looking but wrong-configuration SKU or placeholder from passing.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core steps are software-controlled after approval; an expected SKU or supported-absence decision is readiness, not manual core work, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies.
